title: Enable OpenAI judge on the Pilobolus style profile
description:
## Intent

As a copy-editing agent, I want the house profile to turn on the OpenAI judge so scan can add voice-aware findings the always-lane misses.

## Gherkin

```gherkin
Feature: Pilobolus judge enabled
  As a copy-editing agent
  I want judge.provider openai on the Pilobolus profile
  So scan can use Terra against house voice

  Scenario: Judge configured
    Given publications/pilobolus/style-profile.yml
    When I load the profile
    Then judge.provider is openai
    And the default model is the documented Terra id
```
